title: NMOS source follower (common-drain buffer)
description: Design an NMOS source-follower (common-drain) unity-gain buffer, current-source biased, that holds small-signal voltage gain between 0.90 and 0.999 V/V at 1 kHz across the full sky130-style tt/ss/ff process corner, 1.62-1.98 V supply, and -40..125 C temperature matrix.

target_specs.corners: sky130-style tt/ss/ff process x 1.62-1.98V supply x -40..125C

reference.notes: Generic (non-PDK) NMOS model stands in for a sky130 device -- see sf.spice/models.lib headers and README.md's 'Known limitation' note.

source.citation: Source follower is a standard first analog IC design course topic; framed here in the style of AnalogCoder's (Lai et al., AAAI 2025, arXiv 2405.14918) easy-tier task set, not reproduced from that repo (unlicensed).
